opening.argument: The video presents a practical browser-remediation workflow, expressly framed around removing viruses and advertising from Chrome, Firefox, Opera, Yandex, Edge, and Explorer. Its instructions focus on isolating and inspecting the affected computer: viewers are told to “disconnect the computer from the network and check the tasks planner,” then review or delete tasks, examine installed programs by installation date, and check the hosts file. That sequence is consistent with technical education and operational troubleshooting rather than an established deceptive scheme. The material does not establish that the named software is malicious, nor does it demonstrate resulting loss or deception, leaving the alleged harmfulness and any scam outcome unproven.

citations.quote: How to remove viruses and advertising in the browsers Chrome, Firefox, Opera, Yandex, Edge and Explorer
First, it is necessary to disconnect the computer from the network and check the tasks planner.
Go to the Control Panel Programs and components and sort the programs installed according to the date of the last installation
in the end you need to check the hosts file
